personality: 7 Dark-First Utility structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, premium streaming environment that balances immersive glass surfaces with high-performance utility for live EPG tracking.

spacing.rule: Generous cinematic spacing for hero cards, tighter athletic spacing for EPG lists to allow quick scanning.

do's: Use blur on the bottom tab bar.
Use blur on sticky horizontal category chips.
Use heavy tinted glass for the video player overlay controls.
dont's: Do not use blur on standard channel list rows.
Do not use blur behind dense EPG timeline grids.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce KIZILKAN PLAYER and prompt the user to add their first playlist.

states.empty: Cinematic dark background with abstract red/theme smoke (Netflix-style), a large logo, and a primary CTA 'Oynatma Listesi Ekle'.
states.error: Standard error overlay with retry button.

screens.layout: Full-screen background image with a dark gradient scrim (top to bottom). The primary CTA is positioned in the thumb zone (lower 1/3) using a glass container.

screens.name: Add Playlist (M3U / Xtream)
screens.purpose: Provide three entry methods for IPTV credentials: M3U URL, File, or Xtream Codes.

states.error: Shows connection/auth error below the form inputs.

screens.layout: Segmented control or 3 large selectable cards at the top to choose the method. Single-column form layout below with sticky 'Kaydet' (Save) CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Live TV (Home)
screens.purpose: Browse and discover channels organized by categories with live EPG data.

states.loading: Skeleton rows simulating channel logos and progress bars.
states.empty: Illustration indicating no channels found in this category.
states.error: Message prompting to refresh the playlist.

screens.layout: CRITICAL: A sticky horizontal scrollable row of category chips (Tümü, Ulusal, Spor, Sinema, etc.) sits at the top under the header. Below is a vertical list of channels. Each row features a channel logo (base64/URL), channel name, EPG 'Now / Next' text, and a horizontal progress bar indicating elapsed program time. Use Glass effect on the sticky category row.

screens.name: EPG Timeline
screens.purpose: A full electronic program guide grid showing current and upcoming shows.
screens.layout: A horizontal and vertical scrolling grid (like a traditional TV guide). Time blocks are mapped horizontally, channels vertically. Current time is highlighted with a vertical brand-colored line.

screens.name: Video Player
screens.purpose: Immersive, distraction-free playback of HEVC/4K/TS streams.

states.error: Clear playback error message with a 'Tekrar Dene' button.

screens.layout: Forced landscape (or auto-rotate). Video fills the screen. A glassmorphic control overlay fades in on tap, featuring a play/pause button, progress scrubber, codec info overlay (HEVC/4K tags), aspect ratio toggle, quality selector, and PiP button.

screens.name: Search & Favorites
screens.purpose: Quickly find channels or access saved favorites.

states.empty: Search: 'Kanal ara...'. Favorites: 'Henüz favori kanalınız yok.'

screens.layout: Search tab has a prominent top search bar and a grid/list of results. Favorites tab displays a list identical to the Live TV channel rows (with EPG and progress).

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage app preferences, themes, and parental controls.
screens.layout: Grouped list view. A prominent 'Tema Seçimi' (Theme Selection) section showing 4 selectable options (Netflix, Turkish Flag, Modern, Vu IPTV). Other settings include buffer size, external player toggle, playlist management, and a disabled/roadmap Parental PIN.

onboarding_hero.alt: Cinematic dark abstract red smoke for splash

instructions_to_main_agent: Read the `themes` object in this JSON carefully. The app supports 4 themes. Ensure you implement a ThemeContext provider that allows swapping between `netflix`, `turkish_flag`, `modern`, and `vu_iptv` palettes. Default to `netflix`.

Implement the Turkish Flag theme subtly - use the colors (`#1A0205` / `#E30A17` / `#FFFFFF`) and perhaps a subtle crescent-star SVG watermark in the empty states or header, but avoid making it look tacky.
CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: The Live TV screen MUST have a sticky horizontal chip filter row for categories right below the header. It must remain visible while scrolling the channel list.
For the EPG in the channel list, ensure you render a horizontal progress bar under the 'Now' program text to indicate how much time has elapsed.
Ensure the UI is entirely in Turkish (e.g., 'Canlı TV', 'Arama', 'Favoriler', 'Ayarlar').
Use Phosphor icons. Keep them filled for active tabs, outlined for inactive.
Make the Video Player robust with controls (Play/Pause, Codec Info, AR, Quality) layered over the video using absolute positioning and a glass effect. Utilize expo-screen-orientation for landscape.
Settings should feature a visual theme picker.
Include gradient scrims (top-to-bottom) on the onboarding background image before overlaying text.
The parental PIN setting should be visible but marked as 'Yakında' (Coming Soon) or disabled for this phase.
